id.description: Stable identity, unique per entity type (§ 11).

owner.description: Accountable role or team (a reference; not validated) (§ 3).

test_requires.description: Capabilities used only by this component's tests (integration scope); resolved like requires, exempt from layer, cycle and domain rules, context slices and fakes (§ 3).

bindings.description: Required capability ID -> provider component ID.
bindings.title: Bindings

fakes.description: Required capability ID -> test double under test_paths that stands in for its provider (§ 3).

external.description: Provider outside this system (platform, third-party API): provides only; exempt from layers, domains, budgets and tests; a drift target whose own sources are not scanned (§ 3).

realized_by.description: Import ID of the child subsystem specification realizing this component (§ 3).

via.description: Required capability ID -> required capability mediating it at runtime (e.g. a transaction platform); no direct code dependency expected (§ 3).
